sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Refrigerated Logistics Warehousing for Perishable Pharmaceuticals

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with significant Common Law influence in corporate and commercial matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012)
Panama–United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 1985)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley N° 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (as amended by Ley N° 70 de 2019) and its implementing regulations, Executive Decree No. 1 of 2016 (AML/CFT Regulation); Ley N° 70 de 2019 (Final Beneficiary Registry) and its implementing Executive Decree No. 129 de 2020

Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notaría Pública de Panamá / Registro Público de Panamá

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Poder Notarial (Power of Attorney) executed by incorporator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary of the jurisdiction where the grantor is located

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registro Público de Panamá / Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, officers, shareholders holding 10% or more, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU asset freeze lists, and Panama's Lista Nacional Vinculante. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons (PEPs), including family members and close associates, with annual filing obligations and senior-management approval for risk acceptance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Online Name Search and Reservation (Registro Digital) via https://www.registro-publico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be registered in any language using the Latin alphabet. Non-Latin script names must be transliterated into the Spanish alphabet. All corporate documents must be filed in Spanish or accompanied by a certified/sworn translation into Spanish.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or registered agent may file a reconsideration petition (recurso de reconsideración) before the Technical Directorate of the Registro Público within five (5) business days of notification. If denied, an administrative appeal (recurso de apelación) must be filed before the Director General of the Registro Público within three (3) business days. A further judicial remedy may be pursued through the contentious-administrative chamber of the Supreme Court of Panama.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may be used as the registered address for a passive holding S.A.; however, for a licensed cold-storage logistics business (ISIC 5210), a physical operating premises is mandatory to demonstrate commercial substance, obtain sanitary and customs permits, and satisfy unannounced inspection requirements. A mere virtual office will not suffice.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for corporate registry inspections (10–15% annual), but high (75% or more) once operational for inspections by the Ministry of Health and other food and pharmaceutical logistics authorities.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation (búsqueda y reserva de nombre)
Public deed of incorporation before Panamanian notary (Escritura Pública de Constitución)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary fee schedule per Panamanian law

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of corporation in the Public Registry (Inscripción de la Sociedad)
Resident agent and registered office service (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed resident agent (abogado or licensed trust/firm)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO / Final Beneficiary Registry filing (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
Apostille and/or consular legalization of corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Panamá / relevant consulates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedules and apostille tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN and sanctions screening of UBOs, directors and officers
Corporate legal fees for due diligence, drafting and preliminary opinion

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (Panama General Corporation Law), as amended by Ley No. 26 de 2000 and Ley No. 5 de 2016 — key provisions: Article 1 (subscription of shares), Article 1-A (licensed Resident Agent), Article 4 (first Board of Directors), Article 23 (registered office), Articles 24–25 (share capital and issuance) and Articles 37–38 (statutory corporate records).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Dirección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas (Sección Mercantil / Mercantile Registry)

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); operational portal: SISTEMA TAX (https://sistematax.dgi.gob.pa). Municipal fiscal permit (Aviso de Operación) is issued by the local Alcaldía.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must first incorporate or register a Panama entity/branch at the Registro Público through a licensed attorney and appoint a resident agent. Subsequently: (1) obtain the Aviso de Operación from the competent municipality; (2) register with the DGI to obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente), submitting corporate charter, bylaws, registered office certificate, resident agent appointment, and notarized power of attorney; (3) enroll in the electronic invoicing system and obtain the ITBMS registration; (4) if exporting, register with the Dirección Nacional de Aduanas as an exporter. Foreign entities with a permanent establishment may obtain a Panamanian RUC directly through their resident agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope — a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima is a separate juridical person subject to corporate income tax only on Panama-source income; capital gains and foreign-source income are generally outside Panamanian tax jurisdiction; distributions to non-resident shareholders are not subject to Panama withholding tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election is available. Available statutory options include: (i) Simplified Small-Taxpayer Regime (Régimen de Pequeños Contribuyentes) for annual gross turnover not exceeding B/. 36,000 (services) or B/. 60,000 (goods); (ii) Multinational Headquarters Regime (SEM) for qualifying regional headquarters applying a 5% effective rate on specified Panama-source income; (iii) tax-exempt zone regimes (Panamá Pacífico Special Economic Area, Ciudad del Saber, Colón Free Zone); (iv) administrative elections on ITBMS input credits for export-related inventories and fixed assets.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) — Panama value-added tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general de minimis threshold — registration is mandatory for any person undertaking taxable transactions in Panama. A reduced-compliance simplified regime applies to small taxpayers with annual gross turnover not exceeding B/. 36,000 (services) or B/. 60,000 (goods), subject to DGI verification.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) through the DGI SISTEMA TAX platform. The online modality requires real-time transmission of each invoice to the DGI and receipt of a digitally stamped QR/authorization code before issuance; an offline (batch/lot) modality is available only in limited DGI-authorized scenarios. High-volume taxpayers must integrate ERP systems through DGI APIs; phased mandatory rollout is based on economic activity and annual revenue, with non-compliance triggering suspension of fiscal authorization codes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating at 0% ITBMS applies to: (i) physical exports of movable goods evidenced by a valid customs export declaration (DUA) confirming departure from Panamanian territory; (ii) services rendered to non-residents for use or consumption entirely abroad, provided the benefit is realized outside Panama and the service is not connected with taxable activities in Panama; (iii) services directly linked to exported goods. For ISIC 5210 cold-storage warehousing, services physically performed in Panama for local principals remain standard-rated at 7%; zero-rating is available only where the foreign principal receives title/risk offshore and documentary proof of offshore use is maintained.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA — Documento Único Aduanero) duly accepted by the Dirección Nacional de Aduanas
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of the goods from Panama
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Remesa de Divisas) or bank statement showing collection of foreign currency export proceeds
Commercial export invoice issued through the e-invoicing system with the 0% rate and DGI authorization code
Executed supply/service contract with the foreign buyer or overseas principal, plus warehouse delivery records and container/pallet tracking proving physical exit
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI cross-audits customs declarations, e-invoice data, and banking remittance records. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days, or submission of false documentation, will trigger retrospective reassessment, reversal of the zero-rating with collection of the full 7% ITBMS, surcharges of up to 100% of the omitted tax, monthly recargo/interest, and fiscal closure of the credit position. Law 70 of 2019 criminalizes aggravated tax fraud, with imprisonment applicable for evaded amounts exceeding B/. 50,000; penalties apply jointly to the entity, its directors, and the responsible resident agent.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama operates no conventional central bank. Prudential supervision of all licensed banks is vested in the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) under Decree Law 2 of 2008; Banco Nacional de Panamá acts solely as fiscal agent of the Republic and issues no currency. The U.S. dollar is statutory legal tender alongside the balboa (PAB), which circulates only as fractional coinage at a fixed 1:1 parity. Monetary and exchange-rate policy are therefore effectively the policy of the United States Federal Reserve, and Panamanian authorities impose no independent FX monetary framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Panamanian regime provides full current-account and capital-account convertibility with zero exchange-control approvals, zero prior licensing of foreign-currency transactions, and zero profit-remittance authorization requirements. A Sociedad Anónima engaged in cold-chain logistics may freely receive equity injections, borrow externally, and remit dividends or loan repayments in USD or any convertible currency. The only fiscal frictions are Panamanian territorial taxation (corporate income tax at 25%; dividend tax of 10% on distributions out of taxed reserves, 20% out of non-taxed or foreign-source income) and standard AML/FIU reporting, including currency transaction reports for cash operations above US$10,000. No balance-of-payments registration or IMF-purpose-code declaration is required by the SBP.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no statutory surrender rules, no mandatory conversion ratios, no repatriation deadlines, and no export-proceeds retention quotas. Refrigerated warehousing and logistics service exports may be invoiced and collected in USD or any freely convertible currency, with the full commercial value retained offshore or onshore at the company's discretion. The only obligations are (i) proper recognition in G/L in balboas at the fixed rate, (ii) invoice substance for territorial-tax purposes, and (iii) standard FIU (Unidad de Análisis Financiero, UAF) transaction reporting by the receiving bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Demand Deposit plus Treasury/Escrow sub-account
Operational Account with domestic ACH and SWIFT payout capabilities
Multi-currency settlement account and capital escrow account
Operational Account complemented by trade finance and documentary credit desk
Operational account for public-sector payment flows and fiscal agency services
Operational Account and payroll ACH disbursement account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for ancillary receivables collection but Low as a primary operating or treasury bank. Foreign digital EMIs such as Wise and Airwallex do not hold Panamanian banking licenses, cannot issue documentary credits, cannot maintain accounts eligible for local ACH clearing, and are not covered by the Panamanian deposit guarantee or SBP supervision. Locally licensed electronic-payment providers, authorized under Panama's Fintech Innovation Law No. 235 of 2022 and related SBP regulations, may offer digital multi-currency wallets; however, their capability is restricted to a regulatory sandbox, with low monthly volume caps and manual KYC/AML settlement checks, making them unsuitable for pharmaceutical trade settlements, escrow requirements, and high-value cold-chain disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: SBP-licensed banks require face-to-face or video-certified identification of the ultimate beneficial owner; fully remote opening is permitted on an exceptional basis only when a licensed Panamanian resident agent or attorney attests the UBO's identity, address, source of funds, and the authenticity of passports and corporate documents. In practice, Tier 1 institutions mandate at least one in-person interview at the Panama City branch for the UBO or the legal representative, during which original passports, the registered Escritura Pública, the share ledger (Libro de Acciones), and the board resolution delegating account-opening authority are presented. Directors resident abroad need not travel if the board resolution validly designates a local officer, resident agent, or treasurer to sign, provided that the beneficial-ownership schedule (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) is filed with the SBP registry.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated S.A. receiving a large lump-sum capital injection (above US$1,000,000) within 90 days of registration
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Escritura Pública and Mercantile Registry certificate dated within 30 days; share subscription and payment agreement; board resolution attesting the source of funds; audited parent-company financial statements; bank reference letter from the remitting institution; the underlying share-purchase or facility agreement; and the Panama FIU-pattern declaration of purpose (proposed use of funds for cold-store fit-out and chiller equipment).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership chain routed through BVI, Seychelles, Bahamas, or other offshore vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete ownership chart through to the final natural persons; notarized and apostilled passports; tax-residence certificates of each UBO; evidence of physical substance (lease or owned facility for the cold-storage operation); legal opinion from a licensed Panamanian counsel confirming the absence of bearer shares and nominee structures under Law 47 of 2013 reform; and a written group commercial rationale.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP, politically exposed, or sanctions-adjacent shareholders or counterparties in Latin American pharma supply chains
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth report and independent wealth verification; full PEP status disclosure; corporate authorization from the ultimate holding company; transaction-monitoring commitment letter; enhanced due-diligence questionnaire; and evidence of arm's-length rental/concession contracts for the warehousing premises.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pharmaceutical cold-chain operator appearing without visible health or sanitary licensing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid MINSA (Ministerio de Salud) / Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas (DDRP) operating permit for storage and distribution of perishable and temperature-controlled products; GDP/GMP certification of the facility or contractual joint-venture with a licensed operator; quality agreement with the pharmaceutical client; temperature-monitoring validation report; and the client offtake contract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanction-list name hits affecting freight forwarders, equipment vendors, or beneficial owners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written UAF/OFAC screening logs proving due diligence; copies of corporate registries demonstrating distinct identity; attestation from the resident agent; request for a refreshed World-Check/Bureau van Dijk report under applicable data-protection consents; and an updated AML compliance manual covering the Panamanian statutory framework (Law 23 of 2015) and post-FATF enhanced-monitoring expectations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route the parent's remittance as a SWIFT MT103 to the Panama bank's USD nostrum, with the beneficiary field referencing the S.A.'s exact corporate name and account number and the remittance information field stating 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION - SHARE SUBSCRIPTION - NOT AN INVOICE'. Panama has no currency-control purpose-code declaration, but the receiving bank will screen the transaction under its AML program and may file an FIU/UAF report; therefore the company must deliver the share subscription agreement, shareholder meeting minutes authorizing the capital increase, the Public Registry filing receipt, and the board resolution authorizing the account. Same-day USD value is achievable through Fedwire/CHIPS from New York correspondents; funds over US$500,000 may trigger automated enhanced due diligence, so pre-position the evidentiary dossier with the relationship manager before the wire is sent.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For supplier payments below US$250,000, use SWIFT MT103 corporate-to-corporate transfers settled through the bank's New York correspondent. For high-value pharmaceutical procurement, use commercial documentary letters of credit (MT700 issuance with MT707 amendments) payable at sight or 30 days after bill-of-lading date, conditioned on presentation of commercial invoice, airway bill, GMP certificate, and the quality certificate. Domestic operational flows (utilities, payroll, cold-storage transport, local maintenance) execute through the Panamanian ACH Direct rail (Cámara de Compensación Automatizada) and same-day Bank Wire; all systems ultimately settle in USD via the local bank's clearing positions with the U.S. Federal Reserve and correspondent banks.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OTC outright forwards in USD/EUR and USD/GBP with tenors of up to 12-18 months under a standard local ISDA or bank master agreement for procurement of European pharma equipment and reagents
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR, USD/CHF) with licensed international banks governed by ISDA/CSA, used to align long-term ECA-financed cold-storage equipment with local-currency amortization
European-style FX options and zero-cost collars (USD/EUR) to protect tender-price certainty on logistics service contracts denominated in EUR
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in selected emerging-market currencies (CNY, COP, BRL, MXN) transacted through global dealing desks; Panama imposes no exchange-trading or OTC derivative restriction

Embedded cross-currency swaps in export-credit agency financing packages for chillers, HVAC, and warehouse robotics, where the export credit carries a local-market benchmark and the Panamanian borrower pays USD

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (Informe Anual) of the Sociedad Anónima together with payment of the annual franchise tax for the Panamanian Public Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá; payment coordinated with the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 30 June of each calendar year; the deadline is not tied to the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing accrues the statutory late surcharge and places the S.A. in registry default; failure to file or pay for three consecutive annual cycles may trigger administrative strike-off and dissolution by the Registro Público, in addition to loss of good standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración Anual de Renta) covering Panama-source income from the refrigerated warehousing activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 March immediately following the calendar fiscal year for a 31 December year-end; for a non-calendar fiscal year, within three months after the fiscal-year closing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of up to 10% of the tax due plus monthly interest; continued non-filing blocks issuance of the Paz y Salvo tax-clearance certificate and may expose the company and its representative to DGI collection or administrative fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner declaration (Declaración de Beneficiario Final) reflecting current ultimate shareholders and any shareholding transfers during the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Registro de Beneficiarios Finales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in the calendar-year compliance cycle; the declaration must be updated by the resident agent whenever a share transfer changes beneficial ownership and must be confirmed at least once per calendar year with the annual report window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or late filing may subject the S.A. to administrative sanctions under Law 23 of 2015 and prevent the resident agent from issuing good-standing and legalization certificates, while blocking normal Public Registry transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No universal Panama statutory audit threshold applies to a standard non-listed Sociedad Anónima solely on the basis of assets or revenue; an independent audit is compulsory when required by the company's bylaws, a bank or licensed-party covenant, a grant of concession, the sanitary or regulatory license for the cold-storage operation, or special tax-administration disclosure requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panamanian financial records are maintained under International Financial Reporting Standards as adopted by the Panamanian accounting authorities; a private cold-storage S.A. may apply IFRS for SMEs when eligible, with the United States dollar as the functional reporting currency.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain and verify ultimate beneficial-owner information at the time of any share transfer and update the DGI's beneficial-owner registry without undue delay. An annual no-change or updated confirmation is compulsory regardless of whether shareholding has changed, and confirmation must be completed before the Public Registry annual report is treated as compliant. Share transfers are opposable to third parties only after being recorded in the statutory Register of Members, and the same transfer record forms the basis of the UBO update.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (Libro de Actas) containing shareholder and board resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$450 – US$1,500 per year for resident agent services and registered office, including annual-report coordination and UBO compliance administration
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,500 – US$8,500 per year for a certified independent audit of a mid-size Panamanian cold-storage and refrigerated-logistics S.A., depending on inventory volume, transaction counts, and intercompany activity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sectoral tax holiday applies to domestic refrigerated warehousing. The standard 25% corporate income tax applies exclusively to Panama-source income under the territorial tax system (Fiscal Code Art. 693). Law 62 of 2020 grants preferential graduated brackets only to legal entities with annual gross revenue not exceeding B/. 1.5 million: first B/. 11,000 of taxable income exempt, intermediate bands at 15%, excess at 25%. Logistical income derived wholly from services performed outside Panama may be excluded as foreign-source. Special regimes (Colon Free Zone, Panama Pacifico, SEM, GAFES) are not available to a purely domestic cold-storage S.A. and therefore confer no rate reduction in this case.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 125 (Declaración de Renta Anual) together with mandatory annexes (transfer-pricing annex, beneficial-owner annex, and economic-substance annex where applicable); electronic filing and payment via the T@PA portal of the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), https://www.dgi.gob.pa.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return due within three months after the close of the fiscal year. For calendar-year Panamanian S.A.s (default), the filing deadline is 31 March of the following year. For DGI-approved non-calendar fiscal years, the return is due three months after fiscal year-end. Separate quarterly or semiannual advance-payment obligations attach during the fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) number, digito verificador, registered corporate name, fiscal address, and resident legal representative details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-owned S.A. must be pre-registered with the DGI through a Panama-domiciled attorney-in-fact; the non-resident shareholder list and corporate charter must be filed, and the resident legal representative signs on behalf of the entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross receipts from Panama-source commercial and industrial activities: cold-storage fees, handling, packing, temperature-monitoring services, and ancillary logistics charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only revenue derived from services used or consumed in Panama (territorial source). Export-related warehousing revenue generated with no Panamanian nexus remains outside the taxable base; supporting contracts and customs documentation must evidence the foreign source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating deductions: utilities, refrigeration electricity, wages and social security, maintenance, insurance, rent or depreciation of cold-storage facilities and equipment, licenses, and APOC-compliant administrative expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions are allowed only when causally linked to Panama-source gross income and supported by original invoices recorded with the DGI. Related-party charges must satisfy the arm's-length standard and be documented in the transfer-pricing annex.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 31 – Net Taxable Income after NOL
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Renta neta gravable after applying net-operating-loss carryforward (maximum 5 years, FIFO basis).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses derived from Panama-source activities are eligible; the tax-loss reconciliation must match audited financial statements and schedules retained for DGI inspection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT computed at 25% (or the Law 62/2020 graduated bands where eligible), reduced by creditable prepayments and, where applicable, the 10% minimum advance dividend tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the S.A. has no Panama-source income, file a nil return; consolidation with the foreign parent is not permitted. The standard 25% rate applies only to Panamanian-source taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance instalments equal to 100% of the preceding year's ISR liability, payable in two installments per the DGI annual schedule, creditable against the final CIT due with Form 125.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Advance payments attach to the registered Panamanian entity even where all profits are ultimately remitted abroad; failure to pay anticipos triggers surcharges and interest irrespective of the final-year tax position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final ISR payable or saldo a favor resulting from the return; payment is issued through the T@PA system in Balboas (US dollars).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must not settle corporate tax from personal funds; payment must originate from the S.A.'s Panamanian bank account using the DGI collection code to avoid characterization as undeclared capital contribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Mandatory electronic annexes: transfer-pricing informative declaration, economic-substance declaration (where the cold-storage activity qualifies as a covered distribution/logistics activity), and beneficial-ownership annex.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offshore-privileged S.A.s in cold-chain logistics remain obliged to file the substance and beneficial-owner annexes even when the income tax return shows a nil balance; omission triggers automatic penalties and loss of tax-residence certification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment: 10% surcharge on the tax due for the first month, plus 1.5% per month or fraction thereafter (Fiscal Code Art. 711). Late filing: penalty of 5% per month or fraction of the tax due, capped at 25% (Fiscal Code Art. 711-A); omission of the return attracts a fine between B/. 50 and B/. 500. Continued non-compliance triggers RUC suspension, closure of the establishment, forced collection against bank deposits, and travel bans (vedas de salida) against responsible directors.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding on dividends distributed from profits already subject to corporate income tax; 20% on distributions sourced from untaxed profits or sheltered reserves. Panamanian S.A.s are additionally subject to an annual minimum advanced dividend tax equal to 10% of taxable income, creditable against the final dividend WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a Double Taxation Agreement (DTA): (i) the non-resident beneficial owner obtains a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from its jurisdiction's competent authority; (ii) the TRC, together with a declaration of beneficial ownership and the applicable treaty-relief form, is submitted to the Panamanian withholding S.A. before the distribution/remittance date; (iii) the S.A. files the documentation with the DGI Treaty Office for verification and, where required, obtains a reduced-withholding authorization or processes a refund. All supporting documents must be retained for five years. Panama's DTA network (16 treaties in force, including Mexico, Netherlands, Singapore, Spain, UAE, France, Italy, and Portugal) reduces the source rate to 5–10% in most cases; absent a treaty, the full statutory rates apply.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid by a Panamanian S.A. to non-residents: 12.5% WHT on gross Panama-source interest (exempt for interest on deposits with licensed Panama banks). Royalties, technical-assistance fees, and payments for use of trademarks, patents, and know-how in Panama: 12.5% WHT (Fiscal Code Art. 733). Treaty rates may reduce interest and royalties to 5–10% (e.g., Spain: 5%; Mexico: 10%); the DTA protocol described above governs the reduced rate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Panama's transfer-pricing regime (Law 62 of 2020, Fiscal Code Art. 762-A) mandates a Local File and the transfer-pricing annex to Form 125 where the taxpayer's annual gross revenue is ≥ B/. 2.5 million or related-party transactions in the fiscal year are ≥ B/. 500,000. A Master File is required for multinational groups with consolidated annual revenue ≥ USD 750 million. Documentation must be submitted to the DGI within 10 business days of a formal request and is subject to penalty for untimely or incomplete delivery.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP – Comparable Uncontrolled Price Method (Método del Precio No Controlado Comparable)
Resale Price Method (Método del Precio de Reventa)
Cost Plus Method (Método del Costo más Margen)
TNMM – Transactional Net Margin Method (Método del Margen Neto Transaccional)
Profit Split Method (Método de División de Utilidades)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Law 129 of 2020 and Executive Decree 82 of 2021) apply to S.A.s conducting 'covered activities,' which include distribution and logistics centers. A refrigerated cold-storage operator classified as a Large Taxpayer (annual gross revenue exceeding B/. 30 million or total assets exceeding B/. 40 million) must file an annual economic-substance declaration and demonstrate: physical premises in Panama, adequate qualified local staff, material local expenditure, and core income-generating activities (CIGA) performed in Panama. Non-compliance triggers fines up to B/. 500,000 and revocation of the company's tax-residence certificate.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentional under-declaration of Panama-source cold-storage revenues; use of offshore shell entities to invoice storage fees; suppression of point-of-sale or DGI electronic invoicing records; and artificial inflation of deductible costs through circular invoicing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil: deficiency assessment plus 10% first-month surcharge and 1.5% monthly interest, together with a penalty of 1.0 to 1.5 times the evaded tax. Criminal (Law 70 of 2019): imprisonment of 3–5 years where the evaded amount exceeds B/. 300,000; aggravated fraud through false invoices raises the penalty to up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, CFOs, and the resident legal representative are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax, surcharges, and fines. The DGI may impose travel bans, seize personal bank accounts, and refer non-resident directors for criminal indictment, including extradition where applicable.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Panamanian S.A. with nominee directors, no physical premises, no local payroll, and no genuine CIGA for the cold-chain distribution activity; filing a false economic-substance declaration or omitting the beneficial-owner registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic-substance declaration failure: fines from B/. 1,000 per month up to B/. 500,000 (Law 129/2020); deregistration of the RUC and cancellation of tax-residence certification; Penalties under the Beneficial Ownership Registry (Law 52/2016 and Decree 82/2021) of up to B/. 50,000 for non-registration or false disclosure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors face personal liability for acts executed without corporate substance, piercing of the corporate veil against the beneficial owners who directed the sham, disqualification from holding Panamanian directorships, and criminal exposure under the AML and economic-substance frameworks.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting cash or opaque third-party payments for warehouse services above the USD 10,000 UAF reporting threshold without filing Suspicious Transaction Reports; failing to identify the beneficial owners of client entities; maintaining bank accounts whose transactional pattern contradicts the stated cold-storage business purpose.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: UAF fines of USD 10,000–100,000 per violation, elevated to USD 200,000 for serious or repeated breaches; administrative suspension of the operating license for refrigerated logistics; and judicial freezing of the S.A.'s assets pending investigation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and designated compliance officers are criminally liable for deliberate failure to report suspicious operations (Law 23, Art. 23) with imprisonment of 2–5 years, personal fines, travel bans, and permanent disqualification from regulated logistics activities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends, remitting profits, royalties, or interest to foreign shareholders without applying the statutory 10% dividend WHT (or 12.5% royalty/interest WHT); undocumented informal remittances; reclassification of loans as permanent equity to avoid dividend WHT; and misuse of treaty certificates without genuine residence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Undocumented remittances: penalty of 30% of the gross amount remitted (Fiscal Code Art. 762-A); default assessment of the omitted WHT at 20% of the distribution plus 10% surcharge and 1.5% monthly interest; recharacterization of shareholder loans as deemed dividends with full WHT, interest, and penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or authorize distributions without proper WHT become personally liable to the DGI for the withheld amounts, penalties, and interest. If the concealed amount exceeds B/. 300,000, criminal tax-fraud charges under Law 70/2019 attach, exposing directors to imprisonment, civil restitution, and international asset-tracing measures.
